seo_title: Rippling vs Employment Hero: AU Payroll & API Audit (2026)
meta_description: Technical audit of Rippling vs Employment Hero for Australian STP Phase 2, Payday Super 2026, and Xero integration architecture.
direct_verdict: Employment Hero is the superior choice for Australian-centric SMEs requiring native Fair Work Award automation and deep local compliance. Rippling wins for global-first organizations needing a unified IT and HR stack with a more robust, developer-friendly API.
product_a_pros: Unified IT and HR management platform
product_a_cons: High configuration overhead for AU Awards
Lack of native Australian-specific compliance depth
product_b_pros: Deep native support for Australian Fair Work Awards
Automated Payday Super and NPP settlement
Strong local market ecosystem and support
product_b_cons: Restrictive API limits for high-scale custom dev
hidden_gotchas: Rippling's modular pricing often hides significant costs for IT management features that are not included in base HR tiers. Employment Hero utilizes a tiered subscription model where advanced rostering and AI payroll features are gated behind higher-cost plans, often requiring expensive add-ons for larger headcount. Both platforms enforce strict contract lock-ins for enterprise-level service level agreements, and API access for Employment Hero is frequently throttled for non-partner accounts, potentially breaking custom middleware syncs during high-volume pay runs.
